data.name: Khizraht
data.gender_notes: Khizraht is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Khizr' meaning 'green' and 'Ard' meaning 'garden'. In Islamic tradition, it refers to a righteous, green-clad Prophet. The name Khizraht carries the meaning “Green Garden” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Khizraht usually hope their child will grow to embody green garden and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Khizraht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Green Garden.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khizraht total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: خزراح
in_arabic.meaning: خزراح تعني الاسم الذي يدل على الخزران واللين
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم خزراح مشتق من الجذر خ-ز-ر، و يعني الاسم الذي يدل على الخزران واللين، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الجن، الآية 16: 'وَأَنَّهُ أَذَّنَ مُنَادِيَهُ فِي اللَّيْلِ فَسَمِعَهُ خَازِرٌ وَهُوَ فِي مَسْفَرٍ'، و الخزر تعني الحماية و الستر، و يدل الاسم على معاني الستر و الحماية و الرحمة

in_urdu.name: خزراح
in_urdu.meaning: خزراح کا مطلب ہے سایہ دار اور محفوظ
in_urdu.long_meaning: خزراح نام عربی زبان کے جڑ خ-ز-ر سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے سایہ دار اور محفوظ، یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں استعمال ہوتا ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیاء میں، جہاں یہ سایہ داری اور حفاظت کی علامت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے، اور اس کا تعلق قرآن کی سورة الجن سے بھی ہے

in_hindi.name: ख़िज़राह
in_hindi.meaning: ख़िज़राह का अर्थ है छाया और संरक्षण
in_hindi.long_meaning: ख़िज़राह नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल से हुई है, विशेष रूप से जड़ ख-ज़-र से, जो छाया और संरक्षण को दर्शाता है, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में उपयोग किया जाता है और अक्सर इसे पवित्र और आध्यात्मिक महत्व के साथ जोड़ा जाता है, जो इस्लामी परंपरा में इसकी जड़ों से जुड़ा हुआ है

in_pashto.name: خزراح
in_pashto.meaning: خزراح د معنا دے سيوري او خوندي
in_pashto.long_meaning: د خزراح نوم د عربي ژبې د ريښو خ-ز-ر څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چي د سيوري او خوندي معنی ورکوي، دا نوم د افغان او پښتن مسلمانانو په دوديزو کې کارول کيږي، او د قرآن کريم د سورت الجن په 16 آيت کې ذکر شوی دی، چي د حمايت او پټنۍ مفهوم ورکوي

in_english.name: Khizraht
in_english.meaning: derived from Arabic roots meaning shaded and protected
in_english.long_meaning: The name Khizraht originates from the Arabic roots 'خ-ز-ر' (kh-z-r), which convey the meanings of shaded, protected, and guarded, referenced in Quranic verse, Surah Al-Jinn, verse 16, symbolizing divine protection and mercy, and carries connotations of safety, shelter, and spiritual guidance across Islamic cultures

data.cultural_impact: Khizraht holds a significant place in Islamic culture, particularly in Sufism, as it represents a devotion to the Prophet Khizr, who is believed to be a guardian of travelers, markers on sacred paths, and a symbol of divine guidance. He is often depicted as a green-clad figure flowing in a river, and travelers seek his blessings by passing a stone over their heads as they recite specific supplications.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, Khizraht symbolizes the endless pursuit of knowledge and wisdom, charity and selflessness, and a longing for divine connection. Prophet Khizr is believed to have embodied these qualities and serves as a model for believers to emulate. The name thus carries profound spiritual significance, reminding us of our own potential for growth and connection with the Divine.
